entry.title: New: dsh-svg-motion
entry.summary: Turn any SVG logo into a motion video inside DSH: an `animate_svg` tool renders a transparent 30fps assembly animation (parts fly in, or the whole mark settles) and synthesizes an MP4 with ffmpeg. Exact install spec: github:weike-zhang/dsh-svg-motion. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
